question: Which Indian author won the 2025 International Booker Prize for the short story collection 'Heart Lamp'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Banu Mushtaq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banu Mushtaq** is an emerging Indian author renowned for her unique storytelling and compelling narratives.
 
• Her short story collection, **'Heart Lamp'**, was critically acclaimed for its deep exploration of human emotions and cultural nuances.
 
• The collection earned her the prestigious **2025 International Booker Prize**, making her one of the few Indian authors to receive this honor.
 
• The **International Booker Prize** celebrates the finest works of fiction translated into English from different languages worldwide, emphasizing global literary excellence.
 
• 'Heart Lamp' stood out for its portrayal of diverse perspectives and rich storytelling, showcasing **Indian culture** on a global platform.
 
• The achievement highlights the growing recognition of **Indian literature** in the international literary community.
 
• This milestone serves as an inspiration for aspiring authors across **India** and beyond, encouraging literary innovation and creativity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jeet Thayil**__

 __
 
• **Jeet Thayil** is a celebrated Indian author and poet, best known for his novel **'Narcopolis'**, which was shortlisted for the **Man Booker Prize** in 2012.
 
• His works often explore themes of addiction, spirituality, and urban life.
 
 
 
• **Deepa Bhasthi**__
 __
 
• **Deepa Bhasthi** is an Indian writer, critic, and translator who has contributed extensively to literature and journalism.
 
• She is recognized for her essays and articles focusing on **art, culture, and socio-political issues.**
 
 
 
• **Pratibha Satpathy**__
 
 
• **Pratibha Satpathy** is an eminent Odia poet and writer, well-known for her contributions to **Indian regional literature.**
 
• She has received several awards, including the **Sahitya Akademi Award**, for her literary works.
